---
title: Watermark
format:
  typst:
    keep-typ: true
    logo: figure.svg
filters:
  - typst-extras
extensions:
  typst-extras:
    watermark: "DRAFT \"v2\""
_quarto:
  tests:
    run:
      extension-test:
        check: pdftotext "$EXTENSION_TEST_OUTPUT" - | tr -d ' \n' | grep -q 'DRAFT“v2”\|DRAFT"v2"' && grep -q 'background:' "${EXTENSION_TEST_INPUT%.qmd}.typ"
    typst:
      noErrors: default
      ensureTypstFileRegexMatches:
        - - 'foreground: typst-extras-watermark\('
          - 'text: "DRAFT'
---

Body text under a watermark.
